info.name: Insurance CRM API
info.description: Postman collection for the branch-centric Insurance CRM backend. Import this file, set collection variables, sign in from base, then call the protected routes. Branch IDs and related record IDs are supplied through variables; branch scope is derived from the selected login token.

item.name: base
item.description: Health check and unauthenticated sign-in requests.

request.description: Checks that the Express server is responding.
Saves the returned JWT to the collection variable token.
Saves the branch JWT to the same token variable.

item.name: Upload document
item.description: Uploads a PDF/JPEG/PNG and links it to a customer, policy, or claim.
